No way; what happened to justify hikes this big?

Shock factor is real: Some #airports pushed double-digit to triple-digit fee increases in a single year, far beyond inflation or traffic growth.

Cost recovery narrative: Operators point to pandemic losses, debt servicing, and delayed capex, now being passed directly to airlines.

Infrastructure catch-up: Expansion projects, terminals, and runways are being front-loaded into charges, rather than spread over time.

#Airlines pay first, passengers next: Higher landing, takeoff, and passenger fees ultimately flow into #ticket prices and route decisions.

Policy question: Are these increases about financial sustainability, or are #airports testing pricing power in a capacity-constrained #aviation market?

Top 5: 
* #Ninoy Aquino International #Manila 
* #Istanbul 
* #Amsterdam #Schiphol 
* #Cairo International
* #Auckland

SHOUTOUT SA MGA POLICE OFFICER SA TAGKAWAYAN POLICE STATION— SCAMMER and wasted a lot of our time!

Here's the story, nabunggo kami ng truck OTW to Manila from Bicol kahapon. Minor damages ang nagawa sa sasakyan na gamit namin pero sa amin na sakay, wala namang nasugatan or something and aminado naman 'yong driver ng truck na kasalanan n'ya so need na lang ng police blotter for insurance. 

It's almost 6AM nangyari 'yong aksidente. So, yon, tumawag kami ng police, they took photos and everything, and asked us na pumunta sa police station to file for the police blotter, which we did. Noong nandoon na kami, they asked us questions and made us wait until 8AM para raw sa notarization ng report. 

'Yong friend ni ante na kasama namin, na aksidente rin sila noon so kung baga s'ya 'yong naging guide namin sa mga steps ng pag handle ng situations and noong narinig n'ya ang notarization, pinag question n'ya na agad kase 'di naman daw 'yon need sa pag-file ng Police Blotter pero 'di na muna namin pinansin kase ang goal lang talaga is maka-alis na agad since may hinahabol kaming time kase may susunduin pa sa airport kaso 'yon, noong 8AM na, hinihingian kami ng 1k para raw sa bayad for notarization which is fishy na agad since last time na nagpa-notarize ako is 200 lang hiningi sa'min. 

Sinabihan pa kami noong police na "edi 'di kayo makakaalis n'yan" noong hesitant pa sila ante na magbayad ng 1k pero ending hinayaan na lang. Bale almost 9AM na kami naka-alis sa Police Station na 'yon which is super TIME CONSUMING. 

Ngayong nandito na 'ko sa Bulacan, nagkaroon na 'ko ng time mag-research and walang lumalabas na need ng notarization kapag magpapa-police blotter or educate me guys if meron pero wala dapat kaming bayaran na kahit na ano sa police station. 

Grabe 'yong sa part na na-agrabyado na nga 'yong kotse, ilang libo rin ang kakailanganin para mapaayos 'yon tapos gagatasan pa ng mga kurakot na pulis na 'to. 🤦🏾‍♂️

@PNPhotline
